title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A file put back during indexing is no longer swept away
summary: A folder deleted while the project is being indexed gets a second sweep once indexing settles. That sweep worked from a stale list and removed files restored in the meantime.

highlights.title: Restoring a file right after deleting its folder
highlights.description: It stayed on disk while navigation lost track of it until the next edit. Checking out a branch that deletes a directory and restores one of its files is enough.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Each deletion and each recreation carries its rank, so the sweep can tell which came last.
The storm test meant to cover this could not: its stand in scanner reported it was never busy, so the sweep never ran in any test.
